editorial:
Imagine meeting a woman who looks young and beautiful but is actually hundreds of years old. That is exactly what happens when you meet Irene, the daughter of a famous Salem witch. She has a dark secret: she needs to kill a group of young people every thirty years to keep her powers and her looks. You will follow Dalton, a guy who is just trying to find peace after his brother died. Irene tricks him by promising he can talk to his brother again, and he brings his friends along for the ride. It starts off as a mysterious trip, but it quickly turns into a bloody nightmare as the group realizes they are just bait for a ritual.

What makes this movie work is the tension and the scary surprises. The acting feels real, and the way the plot unfolds keeps you guessing about who will survive. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the gore and the twists make up for it. If you love stories about evil witches and unlucky teenagers, you should definitely give this a shot. endingExplained: By the end, you see that Irene's plan almost works perfectly. Most of the friends are killed in brutal ways to feed her power. Sam is the only one who manages to fight back and survive the night. After a final struggle, the ritual is interrupted, and Sam barely escapes with her life. The movie leaves you feeling uneasy because it shows that ancient evil is still out there waiting for the next thirty years to pass.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural slashers and creepy witch stories.
